394.name: Over Shield
394.description: Shield skills grant protection to nearby allies. Protection on you gains increased damage reduction.

396.name: Invigorating Speed
396.description: When you gain swiftness or superspeed, you also gain vigor.

413.name: Compounding Chemicals
413.description: Heal yourself when you grant yourself a boon. Remove a condition from yourself when you use an <c=@abilitytype>elixir</c> skill. Gain increased concentration.

429.name: Shaped Charge
429.description: Deal increased strike damage for each stack of vulnerability on your target.

432.name: Explosive Entrance
432.description: Your first attack when entering combat explodes, dealing damage to nearby foes. This ability refreshes after a dodge roll.

433.name: Incendiary Powder
433.description: Burning you inflict lasts longer, and your critical hits inflict burning.

468.name: Hidden Flask
468.description: Drink a Lesser Elixir B when struck while below the health threshold.

469.name: Boiling Point
469.description: Gain fury when you gain might at or above the threshold.

470.name: Blast Zone
470.description: Create a blast finisher at your location when you use a healing skill's associated tool belt skill.

472.name: Anticorrosion Plating
472.description: When you grant protection to an ally, cleanse conditions from them.

473.name: HGH
473.description: <c=@abilitytype>Elixirs</c> gain increased durations and grant might.

482.name: Aim-Assisted Rocket
482.description:
Missile hits launch a rocket at your target. After enough rockets have been fired, an orbital strike is called instead.
This trait has an internal cooldown.

487.name: Transmute
487.description: Drink a Lesser Elixir C when you use a healing skill.

505.name: Shrapnel
505.description: <c=@abilitytype>Explosions</c> have a chance to cripple and cause bleeding on hit.

507.name: Sapping Device
507.description: Weaken enemies when you disable or immobilize them. <c=@reminder>Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.</c>

508.name: Reconstruction Enclosure
508.description: Grant protection to nearby allies when you use a heal skill.

509.name: Protection Injection
509.description:
Gain protection when you are disabled.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

510.name: Heavy Metal
510.description: Your critical-strike chance and critical damage are increased against foes that are below the health threshold.

512.name: Streamlined Kits
512.description: Equipping an <c=@abilitytype>Engineering Kit</c> creates an attack or spell and grants you swiftness.

514.name: Grenadier
514.description: Increase the blast radius of grenades. Using a healing skill casts Lesser Grenade Barrage.

515.name: Serrated Steel
515.description: Critical hits have a chance to cause bleeding. Bleeding you inflict gains increased duration.

516.name: Modified Ammunition
516.description: Deal increased strike damage for each unique condition on a foe.

518.name: Cleansing Synergy
518.description: Using a heal skill triggers a cleansing pulse around you.

519.name: Energy Amplifier
519.description: Your power and healing power are increased while you have regeneration.

520.name: Comeback Cure
520.description: Grant regeneration when you remove a condition from an ally.

521.name: Health Insurance
521.description: Increase your incoming healing effectiveness. Gain increased healing to others while using a med kit.

523.name: Adrenal Implant
523.description: Endurance regeneration is increased. Reduce the recharge of your tool belt skills when you dodge.

525.name: Short Fuse
525.description: Gain fury when you hit a foe with an <c=@abilitytype>Explosion</c>.

526.name: Sharpshooter
526.description: Bleeding you inflict scales off of your power instead of your condition damage.

531.name: Power Wrench
531.description: Reduce the recharge of your elite skill when you dodge.

532.name: Static Discharge
532.description: Discharge a bolt of lightning whenever you use a tool belt skill.

536.name: Hematic Focus
536.description: Gain fury when you inflict bleeding on an enemy. Fury gives an increased critical-strike chance.

1541.name: Grand Entrance
1541.description: Explosive Entrance grants you resistance and increased critical-strike chance for a brief duration.

1678.name: Experimental Turrets
1678.description: <c=@abilitytype>Turrets.</c> Turrets create a reflective barrier when built and grant boons to allies around them on a regular interval.

1680.name: Bunker Down
1680.description: Create a proximity mine at your target's location and a med kit at your location when you disable an enemy.

1832.name: Takedown Round
1832.description: Deal increased strike damage while your endurance is not full.

1834.name: Soothing Detonation
1834.description: Heal nearby allies when using a tool belt skill.

1849.name: Applied Force
1849.description: Gain stability when you gain might at or above the threshold. Might grants bonus power.

1854.name: Chain Reactivity
1854.description: Gain barrier when you successfully finish a combo field with a leap or a blast. Every third successful finish grants you might and a larger barrier that is shared with allies.

1856.name: Kinetic Battery
1856.description: Gain kinetic charges when you use a tool belt skill. At maximum, charges gain a burst of speed.

1860.name: Object in Motion
1860.description: Deal increased strike damage while you have stability, swiftness, or superspeed. This damage increase compounds for each boon you have.

1867.name: Mass Momentum
1867.description: Gain might while you have stability. Your Function Gyro applies stability to allies when cast.

1871.name: Equal and Opposite Reaction
1871.description: Gain quickness and stability when you disable an enemy.

1872.name: Mechanized Deployment
1872.description: Your tool belt skills gain reduced recharge. Tool belt skills remove conditions. <c=@reminder> Engage Photon Forge cannot activate this trait</c>

1877.name: Impact Savant
1877.description: A percentage of the strike damage you deal is converted into barrier.

1878.name: Chemical Rounds
1878.description: Gain condition damage. Your pistol skills gain increased condition duration.

1882.name: Glass Cannon
1882.description: Strike damage dealt increases when above health threshold.

1892.name: Explosive Temper
1892.description: <c=@abilitytype>Explosions</c> grant stacking ferocity when they hit.

1901.name: Automated Medical Response
1901.description: Grant regeneration to nearby allies when you use a healing skill's associated tool belt skill.

1914.name: High Caliber
1914.description: You have an increased critical hit chance against foes within the range threshold.

1916.name: Medical Dispersion Field
1916.description: While in combat, a percentage of healing you apply to yourself is stored by your Medical Dispersion Field. Each interval, stored healing is spent to heal nearby allies.

1917.name: Gyroscopic Acceleration
1917.description: <c=@abilitytype>Well</c> abilities have an increased area of effect and grant superspeed to nearby allies on their first pulse. Your function gyro also grants superspeed to allies when cast.

1923.name: No Scope
1923.description: Critical hits on foes within the range threshold have a chance to grant fury. Fury grants you ferocity.

1930.name: Sanguine Array
1930.description: Gain might when you inflict bleeding on a foe.

1936.name: Excessive Energy
1936.description: Strike damage dealt is increased while you have vigor.

1944.name: Blast Shield
1944.description: Explosive Entrance grants barrier. Gain vitality based on a percentage of your power.

1946.name: Lock On
1946.description:
Striking a stealthed foe triggers Invisible Analysis.
Disabling a foe triggers Controlled Analysis.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

1947.name: Big Boomer
1947.description: Deal increased strike damage to foes with a lower health percentage than you. Hitting with an <c=@abilitytype>Explosion</c> heals you over a few seconds.

1954.name: Rapid Regeneration
1954.description: Regenerate health while affected by swiftness or superspeed.

1959.name: Function Gyro
1959.description: You gain access to the function gyro, which replaces your tool belt skill 5. Gain access to <c=@abilitytype>Gyro</c> skills.

1971.name: System Shocker
1971.description:
Disabling a foe grants barrier to nearby allies. Your function gyro dazes foes when cast.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

1979.name: Optimized Activation
1979.description: Using tool belt skills grants vigor.

1981.name: Ex Machina
1981.description: Function gyro has additional charges, no longer has a recharge penalty, and grants barrier to nearby allies.

1984.name: Juggernaut
1984.description: Gain might while wielding a flamethrower. Might applied to you gains increased duration. Napalm grants you stability and a fire aura.

1997.name: Reactive Lenses
1997.description: Activate Lesser Utility Goggles after using a healing skill.

1999.name: Expert Examination
1999.description: Your function gyro grants protection to allies when cast. Using a healing skill's associated toolbelt skill grants protection to nearby allies.

2006.name: Thermal Vision
2006.description: Gain expertise. Increase your outgoing condition damage when you inflict burning.

2014.name: Speed of Synergy
2014.description: Using a heal skill grants superspeed in a radius around you. Using a healing skill's associated tool-belt skill grants you personal superspeed.

2052.name: Kinetic Accelerators
2052.description:
Grant boons to nearby allies when you successfully combo a field with a blast, leap, or whirl finisher. Your function gyro is now a blast finisher.
Whirl finishers can only trigger this trait once per interval.

2064.name: Photonic Blasting Module
2064.description:
Overheat now blasts damage to nearby foes and no longer deals its initial damage to you. The tool belt recharge penalty for Overheat is reduced. Heat can only be lost after overheating.
Damage over time from Overheat is still applied.

2066.name: Thermal Release Valve
2066.description:
Dodge rolling vents heat as an attack against nearby foes and grants vigor.
(Attack will not occur without heat.)

2091.name: Crystal Configuration: Zephyr
2091.description: Holo Leap removes movement-impairing conditions, grants superspeed instead of swiftness, and inflicts cripple.

2103.name: Crystal Configuration: Storm
2103.description: Photon Forge skill 1 now fires explosive projectiles, but generates extra heat.

2106.name: Solar Focusing Lens
2106.description: Your first few attacks after entering or exiting Photon Forge inflict burning and deal increased strike damage. This bonus is also granted if you overheat.

2114.name: Light Density Amplifier
2114.description: Photon Forge reduces incoming damage but has increased passive heat generation.

2122.name: Laser's Edge
2122.description: While Photon Forge is active, your outgoing strike damage is increased based on your current heat.

2135.name: Heat Therapy
2135.description:
Gain health per unit of heat lost.
This trait does not function while cooling due to an overheat unless Photonic Blasting Module is equipped.

2137.name: Enhanced Capacity Storage Unit
2137.description: Increases maximum heat capacity. While above 100% heat, periodically gain might. Some skills and traits gain additional heat tiers.

2152.name: Crystal Configuration: Eclipse
2152.description: Corona Burst grants a barrier for each target struck.

2157.name: Prismatic Converter
2157.description: Deactivate Photon Forge converts conditions into boons based on your heat level.

2158.name: Photon Projector
2158.description: Photon Forge replaces your tool belt skill 5. Gain access to <c=@abilitytype>Exceed</c> skills.

2266.name: Mech Fighter
2266.description: New combat subroutines enable your mech to use Rocket Punch when you activate Skill 3 on your equipped weapon. Your mech gains a greater percentage of your own toughness and vitality stats.

2267.name: Exigency Protocols
2267.description: When your mech is struck while under half health, it activates Exigency Protocols, gaining damage reduction and regeneration for a short duration. Regeneration boons you apply are stronger.

2270.name: Mech Frame: Conductive Alloys
2270.description: Unlocks the Mech Command skill Discharge Array. Your mech gains a greater percentage of your own condition damage and expertise stats.

2276.name: Mech Frame: Channeling Conduits
2276.description: Unlocks the Mech Command skill Crisis Zone. When you or your mech apply barrier, also grant a boon to the affected target. Your mech gains a greater percentage of your own concentration and healing power stats.

2279.name: Mech Arms: Jade Cannons
2279.description: Melee attacks become ranged, have an increased chance to critically hit, and apply vulnerability. Unlocks the Mech Command skill Spark Revolver.

2281.name: Mech Core: Barrier Engine
2281.description:
Unlocks the Mech Command skill Barrier Burst. While in combat, your mech will automatically grant a small barrier each interval to nearby allies.

The mech does not count against the target count for this trait.

2282.name: Mech Arms: Single-Edge Cutters
2282.description: Unlocks the Mech Command skill Rolling Smash. Your mech's attacks apply bleeding. This effect may only affect a given target once per interval.

2291.name: Mechanical Genius
2291.description:
Through your mechanical genius, you have utilized Canthan jade technology to build a customized battle mech that will fight at your side.
Your mech inherits a percentage of all of your combat attributes except precision, which is added to its own.
Your tool belt skills are replaced with Mech Commands, customized by your trait choices. Mech Commands take longer to recharge when using them far away from your mech.
Gain access to signet utility skills.

2292.name: Mech Core: Jade Dynamo
2292.description: Unlocks the Mech Command skill Jade Mortar. Mech Command skills grant you quickness when used and have a reduced cooldown.

2294.name: Mech Frame: Variable Mass Distributor
2294.description: Unlocks the Mech Command skill Core Reactor Shot. Your mech gains a greater percentage of your own precision stats.

2296.name: Mech Arms: High-Impact Drivers
2296.description:
Unlocks the Mech Command skill Explosive Knuckle. Your mech's attacks now generate might for allies within a radius. This effect may only occur once per interval.

The mech does not count against the target count for this trait.

2298.name: Mech Core: J-Drive
2298.description:
Gain access to the Mech Command skill Sky Circus. While dismissed or away for repairs, your mech supports you with an occasional aerial bombardment.
Signet skills gain improved passive effects and continue to grant their passive bonuses while recharging.

2334.name: Double Helix
2334.description: Evolve has two charges and grants an increased attribute bonus.

2349.name: Silver Lining
2349.description: Evolve no longer inherits bonuses from strains. <c=@abilitytype>Morph</c> skills grant their strain bonuses.

2356.name: Willing Host
2356.description: Using a <c=@abilitytype>morph</c> skill increases your damage for a duration.

2366.name: Stainless Steel
2366.description: Convert conditions to boons when you use a <c=@abilitytype>stance</c> skill or evolve.

2377.name: Experimental Union
2377.description:
Through asuran ingenuity, you are host to a mercurial mold. You are able to command it using selectable morph skills that replace your toolbelt skills or even fully merge with it to evolve into a superior being.
Morph skills selected will alter the composition of the mercurial mold, changing the bonuses it grants you when you evolve.
Gain access to stance utility skills.

2383.name: Carbolic Composition
2383.description: Amalgam skills inflict poison on hit. Poison you inflict lasts longer.

2387.name: New Genes
2387.description: <c=@abilitytype>Morph</c> skills grant boons to allies. Grant an additional boon based on which <c=@abilitytype>morph</c> skill was used.

2389.name: Hybrid Vigor
2389.description: Gain vitality. Gain barrier when you use a <c=@abilitytype>morph</c> skill.

2395.name: Innervating Alloy
2395.description: Heal every second while you have barrier. Heal when you evolve.

2406.name: Symbiotic Synergy
2406.description: Evolve recharges <c=@abilitytype>morph</c> skills. <c=@abilitytype>Morph</c> skills deal increased strike damage.

2420.name: Mercurial Tendencies
2420.description: Disabling an enemy reduces the cooldown of Evolve.

2434.name: Hardened Chrome
2434.description: <c=@abilitytype>Morph</c> skills and evolving grant protection to yourself.

5802.name: Med Kit
5802.description: Engineering Kit. Equip a kit that replaces your weapon with healing skills.

5805.name: Grenade Kit
5805.description: Engineering Kit. Equip a kit that replaces your weapon with grenade skills.

5811.name: Personal Battering Ram
5811.description: Gadget. Launch a target foe with a concealed ram head.

5812.name: Bomb Kit
5812.description: Engineering Kit. Equip a kit that replaces your weapon with bomb skills.

5818.name: Rifle Turret
5818.description: Turret. Build a rifle turret that shoots at foes. Turrets automatically overcharge when they are first placed, and they can be overcharged manually as long as they stay active.

5821.name: Elixir B
5821.description: Elixir. Drink Elixir B to gain fury, might, resolution, and swiftness, then extend the duration of boons on yourself.

5824.name: Smoke Bomb
5824.description: Set a timed charge that creates a cloud of smoke, blinding nearby foes.

5825.name: Slick Shoes
5825.description: Gadget. Spray oil behind you, knocking down foes. If underwater, foes entering the field are blinded and slowed.

5827.name: Fragmentation Shot
5827.description: Fire a shot that bleeds the impacted target and then shatters, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

5828.name: Poison Dart Volley
5828.description: Fire a volley of darts that poison foes.

5829.name: Static Shot
5829.description: Discharge a lightning shot that bounces between multiple foes, blinding and confusing them.

5830.name: Glue Shot
5830.description: Coat the target area with a glue puddle that immobilizes foes on impact, then cripples foes that remain within.

5831.name: Blowtorch
5831.description: Unleash flames from your pistol to burn foes. Deals more damage the closer you are.

5832.name: Elixir X
5832.description: Elixir. Drink Elixir X to become a rampaging brute, whirling tornado, or powerful lich. Underwater, become either a withering plague or a whirlpool.

5834.name: Elixir H
5834.description: Elixir. Drink Elixir H to heal yourself and gain protection, regeneration, and swiftness.

5836.name: Flame Turret
5836.description: Turret. Deploy a turret that burns foes. Turrets automatically overcharge when they are first placed, and they can be overcharged manually as long as they stay active.

5837.name: Net Turret
5837.description: Turret. Build a net turret that immobilizes nearby foes. Turrets automatically overcharge when they are first placed, and they can be overcharged manually as long as they stay active.

5838.name: Thumper Turret
5838.description: Turret. Build a high-health thumper turret that damages nearby foes. Turrets automatically overcharge when they are first placed, and they can be overcharged manually as long as they stay active.

5857.name: Healing Turret
5857.description: Turret. Deploy a turret that heals you briefly, then regenerates you and your allies. Turrets automatically overcharge when they are first dropped, and they can be overcharged manually as long as they stay active.

5860.name: Elixir C
5860.description: Elixir. Drink Elixir C, converting all conditions into boons, then heal yourself per boon on you.

5861.name: Elixir S
5861.description: Elixir. Drink Elixir S to shrink yourself, recover from stun, and evade attacks.

5862.name: Elixir U
5862.description: Elixir. Drink Elixir U, gaining quickness, stability, and vigor.

5865.name: Utility Goggles
5865.description: Gadget. Break out of stun, gaining resistance, clearing blindness, and removing damaging conditions.

5868.name: Supply Crate
5868.description: Turret. Request a supply drop of turrets. Turrets automatically overcharge when they are first dropped, and they can be overcharged manually as long as they stay active.

5893.name: Electrified Net
5893.description: Overcharge your turret to fire an electrified net that immobilizes and stuns.

5900.name: Smoke Screen
5900.description: Overcharge your flame turret, releasing a smoke screen that blinds nearby foes.

5904.name: Tool Kit
5904.description: Engineering Kit. Equip a kit that gives you a variety of tools.

5910.name: Rocket Boots
5910.description:
Gadget. Fly forward, removing movement-impairing conditions and damaging foes with your rocket exhaust. 
Movement-impairing conditions include cripple, chill, and immobilize.

5912.name: Rocket Turret
5912.description: Turret. Build a turret that fires rockets. Turrets automatically overcharge when they are first placed, and they can be overcharged manually as long as they stay active.

5913.name: Explosive Rockets
5913.description: Overcharge your turret to fire explosive rockets.

5927.name: Flamethrower
5927.description: Engineering Kit. Arm yourself with a flamethrower that replaces your weapon skills.

5933.name: Elixir Gun
5933.description: Engineering Kit. Arm yourself with an elixir gun that replaces your weapon skills.

5966.name: Healing Mist
5966.description: Elixir. Vent a healing mist, granting regeneration to yourself and allies.

5968.name: Elixir R
5968.description: Elixir. Drink Elixir R to refill your endurance and remove immobilizing effects.

5973.name: Superspeed
5973.description: Activate your slick shoes, enabling you to move at superior speeds.

5982.name: Launch Personal Battering Ram
5982.description: Shoot a ram's head in front of you, impairing any struck foes.

5983.name: Rocket Kick
5983.description: Use your rocket boots to do an explosive kick that burns foes.

5999.name: Throw Wrench
5999.description: Throw a wrench that returns to you, striking foes each way.

6003.name: Rifle Burst
6003.description: Deliver a quick burst of fire that pierces targets, followed by an explosive grenade.

6004.name: Net Shot
6004.description: Immobilize foes with a net shot.

6005.name: Jump Shot
6005.description: Blast the ground, damaging nearby foes and leaping to your target.

6053.name: Magnetic Shield
6053.description: Create a magnetic field that reflects projectiles and can be released to knock back foes.

6054.name: Static Shield
6054.description: Electrify your shield, preparing to throw it at foes. Stun nearby enemies that attack you while blocking.

6057.name: Throw Shield
6057.description: Throw your charged shield. Dazes foes it hits on the way out and back.

6078.name: Detonate Elixir C
6078.description: Elixir. Burst the bottle, converting conditions into boons for allies in your area.

6082.name: Detonate Elixir B
6082.description: Burst the bottle to grant stability and one of the following boons to allies: fury, might, resolution, or swiftness.

6084.name: Detonate Elixir S
6084.description: Elixir. Burst the bottle, granting allies stealth.

6086.name: Detonate Elixir R
6086.description: Elixir. Burst the bottle, reviving allies.

6088.name: Detonate Elixir U
6088.description: Elixir. Detonate Elixir U, causing it to grant allies superspeed and break them out of stun.

6119.name: Detonate Elixir H
6119.description: Burst a bottle of Elixir H, granting protection, regeneration, and swiftness to allies.

6126.name: Magnetic Inversion
6126.description: Release the magnetic field to knock back nearby foes.

6145.name: Net Wall
6145.description: Launch a deployable net wall to immobilize foes caught within.

6147.name: Scatter Mines
6147.description: Fire out a spread of explosive mines at your enemy.

6148.name: Homing Torpedo
6148.description: Fire a shot that homes in on your foe and detonates an area around them.

6149.name: Timed Charge
6149.description: Fire a timed charge at your target, damaging and burning nearby foes when it detonates.

6153.name: Blunderbuss
6153.description: Fire several shards of shrapnel that inflict more damage the closer you are to foes. You and nearby allies gain might.

6154.name: Overcharged Shot
6154.description: Fire a blast so strong that it launches your foe as the recoil frees you from any movement-impairing conditions.

6159.name: Smoke Vent
6159.description: Vent smoke from your flamethrower, blinding nearby foes.

6161.name: Throw Mine
6161.description: Gadget. Throw out a remote-controlled land mine that damages, knocks back, and removes a boon from nearby foes.

6162.name: Detonate
6162.description: Detonate your mine to damage foes and remove a boon from them.

6166.name: Detonate Mine Field
6166.description: Detonate your mine, damaging nearby foes.

6176.name: Regenerating Mist
6176.description: Release a mist of healing liquid to regenerate nearby allies.

6177.name: Rocket
6177.description: Fire a rocket out of your belt that explodes on impact.

6178.name: Surprise Shot
6178.description: Fire a bullet out of your belt.

6179.name: Net Attack
6179.description: Fire a net from your belt to immobilize your foe.

6180.name: Rumble
6180.description: Release a shock wave of inertial force to damage nearby foes.

6181.name: Throw Napalm
6181.description: Throw a ball of napalm that explodes on impact, burning foes around target location.

13465.name: Lesser Elixir B
13465.description: Elixir. Quaff an elixir, gaining boons.

13552.name: Static Discharge
13552.description: Hit multiple foes with arcs of chain lightning. Critical hits with this ability deal increased damage.

17810.name: Drop Mine
17810.description: Drop a mine that deals damage to enemies that trigger it.

17811.name: Magnetic Bomb
17811.description: Set a timed charge that pulls nearby foes.

17813.name: Fire Shield
17813.description: Activate a fire shield that burns enemies who strike you, granting might for each burn applied.

17814.name: Magnetic Aura
17814.description: Become surrounded in a magnetic shield that reflects projectiles.

17815.name: Glue Trail
17815.description: Leave a trail of glue behind you that hampers enemy movement.

21659.name: A.E.D.
21659.description: Gadget. Activate your A.E.D., enabling the system to heal you after a brief period of time. If you take lethal damage while A.E.D. is active, it ends and heals you for a large amount and removes conditions.

21661.name: Static Shock
21661.description: Use your A.E.D. to stun an enemy.

29473.name: Detonate
29473.description: Detonate your mine to damage foes and remove a boon from them.

29505.name: Reconstruction Field
29505.description: Establish a defensive field, granting protection to allies in its area.

29522.name: Rocket Boots
29522.description: Gadget. Fly forward, damaging foes with your rocket exhaust. Cures immobilized, crippled, and chilled. Gain superspeed when this skill ends.

29591.name: Utility Goggles
29591.description: Gadget. Break out of stun, gaining resistance, clearing blindness, and removing damaging conditions.

29606.name: Invisible Analysis
29606.description: Analyze a stealthed foe, applying vulnerability.

29665.name: Bypass Coating
29665.description: Splash a hypercoating on nearby allies, granting superspeed.

29712.name: Cleansing Pulse
29712.description: Cleanse a condition from nearby allies.

29716.name: Med Pack Drop
29716.description: Call down a supply drop of med packs into a target area.

29722.name: Detonate Elixir X
29722.description: Elixir. Transform. Burst the bottle, transforming enemies.

29739.name: Purge Gyro
29739.description: Well. Deploy a purge gyro to remove conditions from allies in the area.

29772.name: Bandage Self
29772.description: Bandage your wounds and heal yourself.

29785.name: Negative Bash
29785.description: Chain. Slam your hammer into your foe to leave them vulnerable.

29812.name: Lesser Utility Goggles
29812.description: Gadget. Gain resistance, clear blindness, and remove damaging conditions.

29840.name: Shock Shield
29840.description: Block attacks while striking foes in front of you, gaining barrier with each enemy you hit.

29889.name: Aim-Assisted Rocket
29889.description: Fire a seeking rocket at your foe.

29902.name: Drop Gunk
29902.description: Drop gunk at your location to inflict a random condition.

29921.name: Shredder Gyro
29921.description: Well. Deploy a shredder gyro to attack foes in the area and repeatedly use whirl finishers.

29991.name: Personal Battering Ram
29991.description: Gadget. Launch a target foe with a concealed ram head. The ram explodes on contact, burning foes.

30088.name: Electro-whirl
30088.description: Spin around, reflecting missiles and hitting enemies.

30101.name: Bulwark Gyro
30101.description: Well. Deploy a bulwark gyro to grant barrier to allies in the area.

30142.name: Bandage
30142.description: Drop a pack of bandages that provides a little healing.

30262.name: Flashbang
30262.description: Throw an explosive at the target area, dazing and blinding enemies on impact. Remove stealth and reveal enemies in a larger area around the impact.

30337.name: Throw Mine
30337.description: Gadget. Throw out a remote-controlled land mine that damages, knocks back, and removes a boon from nearby foes. A second mine is planted at your location after the first lands.

30357.name: Medic Gyro
30357.description: Well. Deploy a medic gyro to heal allies in the area.

30489.name: Equalizing Blow
30489.description: Chain. Bring down your hammer on your foe.

30501.name: Positive Strike
30501.description: Chain. Smack your hammer into your foe while empowering yourself.

30599.name: Orbital Strike
30599.description: Call down energy from the sky to blast an area.

30665.name: Rocket Charge
30665.description: Dash forward with a rocket-charged hammer to damage enemies.

30713.name: Thunderclap
30713.description: Ionize an area, bringing down the power of lightning to stun foes and damage them over its duration.

30800.name: Elite Mortar Kit
30800.description: Engineering Kit. Equip the mortar kit.

30815.name: Sneak Gyro
30815.description: Well. Deploy a sneak gyro to provide stealth to allies in the area.

30828.name: Slick Shoes
30828.description: Gadget. Spray oil behind you, knocking down foes. Break stun and gain stability. If underwater, foes entering the field are blinded and slowed.

30881.name: A.E.D.
30881.description: Gadget. Activate your A.E.D., enabling the system to heal you after a brief period of time. If you take lethal damage while A.E.D. is active, it ends and heals you for a large amount, grants shock aura, and removes conditions.

31167.name: Spare Capacitor
31167.description: Set down a lightning capacitor to daze and damage foes near it.

31248.name: Blast Gyro
31248.description: Well. Unleash a blast gyro to begin a countdown to a tremendous blast.

40160.name: Radiant Arc
40160.description: Leap to your target and create an arc of light that strikes nearby foes. Gain quickness based on your heat level.

40507.name: Coolant Blast
40507.description: Exceed. Heal yourself and chill nearby foes. If you are above the heat threshold when this skill is activated, gain Frost Aura and continue healing for a duration.

40533.name: Launch Wall
40533.description: Exceed. Launch your photon wall forward, causing the wall to explode when it strikes a foe, inflicting conditions on nearby enemies. When fired above the heat threshold, launch additional walls.

41123.name: Deactivate Photon Forge
41123.description: Cancel Photon Forge and begin cooling after a delay. Cooling effectiveness increases over time.

41218.name: Spectrum Shield
41218.description: Exceed. Break stun effects and create a holographic shell that reduces incoming damage and grants stability. This skill grants more stability and lasts longer while above the heat threshold.

41612.name: Orbital Command Strike
41612.description: Call down energy from the sky to blast an area.

41684.name: Flash Cutter—Storm
41684.description: Fire two light blades in quick succession.

41843.name: Prismatic Singularity
41843.description: Collapse a ring of holograms to pull foes into a single point. The ring explodes when it fully collapses. Radius and pull distance increased while above the heat threshold.

42009.name: Prime Light Beam
42009.description: Exceed. Charge up and fire an explosive beam of light in front of you. When activated above the heat threshold, this attack leaves behind a burning holographic field.

42163.name: Blade Burst
42163.description: Fire holographic blades at foes within range. Damage increased while over the heat threshold.

42475.name: Bright Slash—Storm
42475.description: Launch another arc of light at your target.

42842.name: Laser Disk
42842.description: Exceed. Create rotating laser blades to damage nearby foes. This skill has increased duration when activated while above the heat threshold.

42938.name: Engage Photon Forge
42938.description: Activate your Photon Forge, gaining access to new skills. Generate heat while Photon Forge is active. Take damage if you overheat. Disables use of kits for a short duration.

43176.name: Flash Spark
43176.description: Release a blinding burst of light from your holographic emitter. While above the heat threshold, gain light aura.

43476.name: Sun Edge
43476.description: Strike your foe and inflict vulnerability. This attack deals more damage based on your heat level.

43630.name: Vent Exhaust
43630.description: Damage nearby foes and apply conditions to them. Lose heat. This attack activates Heat Therapy if you have not overheated.

43739.name: Photon Wall
43739.description: Exceed. A defensive barrier appears in front of you that blocks you and your allies from incoming attacks. Reactivate Exceed to fire the barrier at foes as an attack. This skill grants projectile reflection if you are above the heat threshold.

43845.name: Cauterize
43845.description: Use a laser to burn off conditions and set yourself on fire for each condition removed. Removes additional conditions if above the heat threshold.

43937.name: Overheat
43937.description: Reaching the heat maximum results in a self-damaging explosion. Photon Forge is disabled until all heat is lost. Other tool belt skill cooldowns are increased.

44110.name: Refraction Cutter
44110.description: Strike at foes in front of you and launch a blade of light at your target. Launch extra blades based on your heat level. Each blade inflicts conditions.

44260.name: Light Strike—Storm
44260.description: Launch an arc of light at your foe.

44646.name: Hard Light Arena
44646.description: Exceed. Create a holographic arena that grants you boons while inside of it. When activated above the heat threshold, the radius is increased and the user is granted barrier. Allies gain boons at reduced duration.

45581.name: Sun Ripper
45581.description: Strike your foe again and inflict vulnerability. This attack deals more damage based on your heat level.

45709.name: Controlled Analysis
45709.description: Analyze a disabled foe, applying vulnerability.

45732.name: Particle Accelerator
45732.description: Fire a crippling bolt of light at your target. Allies the bolt passes through are granted swiftness. Projectile velocity and damage increased while above the heat threshold.

45979.name: Gleam Saber
45979.description: Unleash a burst of stored energy with your sword and recharge your other sword skills. This attack deals more damage based on your heat level.

49097.name: Lesser Elixir C
49097.description: Elixir. Quaff an elixir, converting conditions into boons.

50380.name: Capture Line
50380.description: Cast out a towline and drag your foe toward you.

56920.name: Function Gyro
56920.description:
Create a lightning field at the specified point. Then summon gyros to finish foes and revive allies within the field. The recharge of this skill is increased for each gyro created beyond the first.
Interrupted gyros are destroyed.

59562.name: Explosive Entrance
59562.description: Your first attack explodes, dealing extra damage to nearby enemies.

63049.name: Rectifier Signet
63049.description:
Signet Passive: Heal yourself and your mech every second.
Signet Active: Heal yourself and your mech.

63050.name: Crash Down
63050.description:
Summon your jade mech at the target area. Foes in the area are damaged. The recharge time of this skill is based on how damaged your mech is.

Right-click to rename your mech.

63077.name: Mace Smash
63077.description: Smash your target with a heavy blow from your mace, inflicting confusion.

63089.name: Recall Mech
63089.description:
Recall your mech for repairs. The cooldown of Crash Down is determined by the amount of damage your mech has taken.

Right-click to rename your mech.

63095.name: Overclock Signet
63095.description:
Signet Passive: Reduces recharge of other signets.
Signet Active: Order your mech to fire its ultimate weapon, the jade buster cannon. If your mech is not present, instead your mech is summoned, even if Crash Down is on cooldown.

63111.name: Shift Signet
63111.description:
Signet Passive: Increases movement speed. Boons you gain are copied to your mech.
Signet Active: You and your mech shadowstep to the target location. Remove conditions on you and your mech.

63113.name: Superconducting Signet
63113.description:
Signet Passive: Increases condition damage dealt.
Signet Active: Creates a damaging field around you that applies conditions to nearby foes. If your mech is active, the field instead radiates from and follows the mech.

63121.name: Jade Mortar
63121.description: Mech Command. Launch a powerful mortar attack at the target.

63141.name: Barrier Burst
63141.description:
Mech Command. Pulse a barrier and boons to all nearby allies.

The mech does not count against the target count for this skill.

63169.name: Energizing Slam
63169.description: Leap forward and smash the ground, inflicting conditions on foes while granting barrier and boons to allies.

63174.name: Mace Blast
63174.description: Smash your target with a final heavy strike, inflicting additional confusion.

63185.name: Rocket Punch
63185.description: Your mech launches an explosive fist that detonates on hit, dealing defiance damage to enemies with active defiance bars. This skill is only used when you activate Skill 3 on your weapon.

63188.name: Spark Revolver
63188.description: Mech Command. Fire a rapid volley of jade energy bolts from both arms, piercing through all enemies.

63210.name: Mech Support: Depth Charges
63210.description: Request a barrage from your mech on the target foe.

63234.name: Rocket Fist Prototype
63234.description: Launch a fist that explodes on the first target hit, damaging and stunning nearby enemies.

63236.name: Sky Circus
63236.description: Mech Command. Your mech jets into the air and fires a missile at each nearby foe before crashing down and dealing additional damage to anything caught underfoot.

63253.name: Force Signet
63253.description:
Signet Passive: Increases strike damage dealt.
Signet Active: Knock foes away from yourself and away from your mech.

63262.name: Barrier Signet
63262.description:
Signet Passive: Incoming strike and condition damage is reduced.
Signet Active: Create a projectile-blocking dome around yourself. You and allies inside the dome gain barrier every second. If your mech is active, the dome is centered on it and is larger. 

The mech does not count against the target count for this skill.

63293.name: Crisis Zone
63293.description:
Mech Command. Your mech removes conditions, breaks stuns, and grants boons to itself and nearby allies.

The mech does not count against the target count for this skill.

63334.name: Rolling Smash
63334.description: Mech Command. Slam at the target with both cutters, inflicting severe bleeding to enemies in the area.

63345.name: Core Reactor Shot
63345.description: Mech Command. Charge up and then release a powerful ball of jade energy at your target that explodes on contact.

63365.name: Explosive Knuckle
63365.description: Mech Command. Order your mech to dash at a target, punching with an explosive strike that weakens enemies near the point of impact.

63367.name: Discharge Array
63367.description: Mech Command. Cycle energy into your mech's armor to turn it into a lightning rod. Jade energy strikes nearby foes and inflicts conditions on them.

63374.name: Jade Buster Cannon
63374.description: Fire the main cannon, obliterating targets in a line. The mech may swivel to track targets while firing the jade buster cannon, but it is unable to move.

68079.name: Rifle Burst Grenade
68079.description: Fire an explosive grenade from your rifle.

68280.name: Defense Field
68280.description: Project a defensive dome and grant stability to allies in the area.

69565.name: Radiant Arc
69565.description: Leap to your target and create an arc of light that strikes nearby foes. Gain quickness.

69906.name: Sun Ripper
69906.description: Strike your foe again and inflict vulnerability.

70514.name: Sun Edge
70514.description: Strike your foe and inflict vulnerability.

70771.name: Gleam Saber
70771.description: Unleash a burst of stored energy with your sword and recharge your other sword skills.

71121.name: Refraction Cutter
71121.description: Strike at foes in front of you and launch two blades of light at your target. Each blade inflicts conditions.

71870.name: Essence of Liquid Wrath
71870.description:
Fire a volley of arrows equipped with a payload that spreads magical flames across the ground on impact, granting boons to allies on the initial detonation and leaving a fire field.

Chain Reaction. The next short-bow skill in the radius will grant an additional boon to allies.

71873.name: Arc Detonator
71873.description: Fire an arrow equipped with an electric module that discharges when striking your target, shocking them and two nearby enemies with an electric blast.

71882.name: Essence of Living Shadows
71882.description:
Fire an arrow equipped with a device that spreads shadow magic across the ground on impact, healing and removing conditions from allies with the initial detonation, and healing allies with each pulse afterward.

Chain Reaction. The next short-bow skill in the radius will remove additional conditions from allies.

71888.name: Essence of Borrowed Time
71888.description:
Fire a row of arrows equipped with a device that envelops an area with chronal magic on impact, stunning enemies and applying superspeed to allies.

Chain Reaction. The next short-bow skill in the radius will daze enemies hit.

72052.name: Essence of Animated Sand
72052.description:
Fire an arrow equipped with a payload that explodes enchanted sand on impact, granting barrier and might to allies.

Chain Reaction. The next short-bow skill in the radius will grant additional might to allies.

72103.name: Function Gyro
72103.description:
Create a lightning field at your location, then summon gyros to finish foes and revive allies within the field.
Interrupted gyros are destroyed.

72114.name: Function Gyro
72114.description:
Create a lightning field at the specified point, then summon gyros to finish foes and revive allies within the field.
Interrupted gyros are destroyed.

72944.name: Puncturing Jab
72944.description: Stab your foe, inflicting bleeding. Inflict vulnerability if your target is focused.

72974.name: Devastator
72974.description: Traverse the area and unleash lighting around you, directly targeting focused foes a number of times.

72977.name: Roiling Skies
72977.description: Charge the earth with electricity, launching focused foes and stunning others.

73001.name: Amplifying Slice
73001.description: Strike your foe, refreshing your focus and bleeding your target. Inflict vulnerability if your target is focused.

73002.name: Lightning Rod
73002.description: Prime your lightning rod to deal damage to nearby enemies. Focused enemies receive extra punishment. Gain charges for your Electric Artillery skill.

73064.name: Focused Devastation
73064.description: Repeatedly strike your foe, inflicting conditions.

73109.name: Rending Strike
73109.description: Swing your spear, inflicting bleeding. Inflict vulnerability if your target is focused.

73122.name: Conduit Surge
73122.description: Leap toward your target, unleashing intense energy on the area if you strike them. Your primary target becomes the focus of your other skills. If a focused target dies, this skill is refreshed.

73143.name: Electric Artillery
73143.description: Hurl your charged rod at a foe, immobilizing them. Foes take increased burning duration and vulnerability stacks based on your lightning rod's charge.

76500.name: Flashbang
76500.description: Throw an explosive at the target area, dazing and blinding enemies on impact. Remove stealth and reveal enemies in a larger area around the impact.

76738.name: Mitotic State
76738.description: Stance. Your slime stimulates your cells to regenerate, healing you rapidly over time. The healing is increased while you have barrier.

76790.name: Locked
76790.description: Select a skill using the arrow above.

76798.name: Defensive Protocol: Cleanse
76798.description: Morph. Convert damaging conditions to barrier and nondamaging conditions to protection.

76806.name: Offensive Protocol: Obliterate
76806.description: Morph. Create a giant blade to maim your enemy. This attack destroys the barrier of enemies hit.

76815.name: Offensive Protocol: Pierce
76815.description: Morph. Thrust forward with a spike, piercing the defense of your foe.

76908.name: Liquid State
76908.description: Stance. Quickly melt down into a puddle, evading all incoming attacks.

76927.name: Offensive Protocol: Demolish
76927.description: Morph. Spin around a hunk of metal, then finish with a forward smash.

76993.name: Flux State
76993.description: Stance. Your slime rapidly spins around you, creating a magnetic field. Pull in nearby enemies as a metallic storm swirls around you.

77018.name: Gaseous State
77018.description: Stance. Sublimate, breaking stun from yourself. Remove movement-impairing conditions and prevent their reapplication.

77069.name: Solid State
77069.description: Stance. Leap into the air as you command your body to compact, stunning enemies upon landing. Gain stability and increase your outgoing stun durations for a duration.

77103.name: Offensive Protocol: Shred
77103.description: Morph. Launch cutting disks at your enemies, piercing enemies in their path. Enemies struck are crippled; if an enemy is struck by all three disks, they are immobilized.

77107.name: Locked
77107.description: Select a skill using the arrow above.

77163.name: Defensive Protocol: Thorns
77163.description: Morph. Grow protective spikes, damaging nearby enemies. For a short duration, the spikes react when you are struck, damaging nearby enemies again.

77209.name: Plasmatic State
77209.description: Stance. Superheat your body and lash out, damaging and burning enemies struck. Your outgoing strike and condition damage is increased for a duration.

77388.name: Locked
77388.description: Select a skill using the arrow above.
